longDescription: Reads account data through the locally installed Kingdee KIS Flagship client (COM): vouchers, account balances, sales and purchase documents, stock on hand, receivables and payables, master data, plus read-only SQL for custom reports. Large result sets can be exported to Excel without consuming conversation context. All operations are read-only. Maintained by a third-party developer; not an official Kingdee product.
tryPrompts: Connect to the Kingdee account set and count this month's vouchers
Show the account balance report for 2026 and export it to Excel
How much stock is left for each item, grouped by warehouse

kis.description: Read-only query tools for a local Kingdee KIS Flagship account set; requires the Kingdee client installed and signed in

kingdee-kis.description: Read-only queries against a Kingdee KIS Flagship account set: vouchers, balances, documents, stock, payables and master data, with Excel export
